mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY WHERE BRC_NAME = #{brc_name}
SELECT * FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY WHERE BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 ORDER BY BRC_NAME ASC

SELECT BRC.*, IFNULL(BR_COUNTS.BRC_UNRESULTED_CNT, 0) AS BRC_UNRESULTED_CNT, IFNULL(BR_COUNTS.BRC_ITEM_CNT, 0) AS BRC_ITEM_CNT FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC LEFT JOIN( SELECT BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO, COUNT(*) AS BRC_ITEM_CNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR.BR_RESULT_NO IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS BRC_UNRESULTED_CNT FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR WHERE BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1 GROUP BY BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO ) AS BR_COUNTS ON BRC.BRC_NO = BR_COUNTS.BR_CATEGORY_NO WHERE BRC.BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 ORDER BY BRC.${sortValue} ${order} LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY WHERE BRC_IS_DELETED = 1
SELECT BRC.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR WHERE BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = BRC.BRC_NO AND BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1) AS BRC_ITEM_CNT FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC WHERE BRC_NO = #{brc_no}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY SET BRC_NAME = #{brc_name}, BRC_MOD_DATE = NOW() WHERE BRC_NO = #{brc_no}
UPDATE BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY SET BRC_IS_DELETED = 0, BRC_MOD_DATE = NOW() WHERE BRC_NO = #{brc_no}
mapper.select: SELECT BRC.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR WHERE BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = BRC.BRC_NO AND BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1) AS BRC_ITEM_CNT FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC WHERE BRC.BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BRC.${searchPart} LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchString}, '%') ORDER BY BRC.${sortValue} ${order} LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY WHERE BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 AND ${searchPart} LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchString}, '%')

SELECT BR.*, BRC.*, BRR.*, U.U_NO, U.U_ID, U.U_NAME, U.U_NICKNAME FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC ON BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = BRC.BRC_NO LEFT JOIN USER_ACCOUNT AS U ON BR.BR_REPORTER_NO = U.U_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_RESULT AS BRR ON BRR.BRR_NO = BR.BR_RESULT_NO WHERE BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BRC.BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 ORDER BY BR.${sortValue} ${order} LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT WHERE BR_IS_DELETED = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT WHERE BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR_STATE = 1

SELECT BR.*, BRC.*, BRR.*, A.A_NO, A.A_ID, A.A_NAME, A.A_DEPARTMENT, A.A_LEVEL, A.A_POSITION, U.U_NO, U.U_ID, U.U_NAME, U.U_NICKNAME FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR JOIN BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC ON BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = BRC.BRC_NO JOIN USER_ACCOUNT AS U ON BR.BR_REPORTER_NO = U.U_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_RESULT AS BRR ON BR.BR_RESULT_NO = BRR.BRR_NO LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT AS A ON A.A_NO = BRR.BRR_ANSWER_A_NO WHERE BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR.BR_NO = #{br_no}

SELECT BR.*, BRC.*, BRR.*, U.U_NO, U.U_ID, U.U_NAME, U.U_NICKNAME FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC ON BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = BRC.BRC_NO LEFT JOIN USER_ACCOUNT AS U ON BR.BR_REPORTER_NO = U.U_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_RESULT AS BRR ON BRR.BRR_NO = BR.BR_RESULT_NO WHERE BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BRC.BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = #{brc_no} ORDER BY BR.${sortValue} ${order} LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT WHERE BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR_CATEGORY_NO = #{brc_no}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORT WHERE BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR_STATE = 1 AND BR_CATEGORY_NO = #{brc_no}

SELECT BR.*, BRC.*, BRR.*, U.U_NO, U.U_ID, U.U_NAME, U.U_NICKNAME FROM BOARD_REPORT AS BR LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_CATEGORY AS BRC ON BR.BR_CATEGORY_NO = BRC.BRC_NO LEFT JOIN USER_ACCOUNT AS U ON BR.BR_REPORTER_NO = U.U_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPORT_RESULT AS BRR ON BRR.BRR_NO = BR.BR_RESULT_NO WHERE BR.BR_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BRC.BRC_IS_DELETED = 1 AND BR.${searchPart} LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchString}, '%') ORDER BY BR.${sortValue} ${order} LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
